title: HostFormAutomationRuleViewDocument
description: Server-maintained manager read view of one organizer automation rule for Host automations and the rule editor, with exactly the rule row listOrganizerFormAutomationRuns returns: the definition, with the webhook secret reduced to whether one is set.
